source='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    """Encode each panel by whether it contains at least two non-background marks."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_edges = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_edges = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ra, rb in zip(row_edges, row_edges[1:]):
        if rb == ra + 1:
            continue
        row = []
        for ca, cb in zip(col_edges, col_edges[1:]):
            if cb == ca + 1:
                continue
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(ra + 1, rb) for c in range(ca + 1, cb)]
            counts = Counter(cells)
            background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
            marks = len(cells) - counts[background]
            row.append(1 if marks >= 2 else background)
        if row:
            out.append(row)
    return out
'''
